result.instructions:
Read-only access to SpatialDDS world-model scenes, over the SpatialDDS web
binding, as any member of the public sees them. Every record says who
asserted it, on what basis (DECLARED, OBSERVED, DERIVED, AUTHORED), when it
was stamped and how old that stamp is, and what the binding has said about
its writer since this server began watching ("nobody asserts this now" when
the writer is gone). Records the binding withdrew while this server watched
are returned marked as no longer served. This server never merges, resolves
or ranks: competing claims about one proposition are returned side by side,
and deciding what to believe is yours. Start with list_scenes.

tools.description: The scenes this server reads, each with its endpoint, its lane and type counts, and how many lanes a reader without a token can read.
tools.name: list_scenes

tools.description: One scene's lanes: each lane's type, access class, durability, record count and published schema, from the binding's search, resources and schemas index.
tools.name: describe_scene

tools.description: The entities a scene serves now, plus any withdrawn while this server watched, with pose, extent, asserter, basis, stamp and age. type matches a type URI or its last segment. near is a point and radius in the scene's frame (x, y, optional z, radius_m, optional frame), measured to an entity's box where it has one.
tools.name: get_entities

tools.description: Relationship claims, every field verbatim, with a one-line rendering. subject matches the subject or the object; predicate matches the URI or its last segment; asserter matches exactly. Claims about one proposition are grouped side by side, never merged or ranked.
tools.name: get_claims

tools.description: One entity, and every claim in which it is the subject or the object.
tools.name: get_entity
